# citation.inator importer (preview, unreleased)

`citation-import.mjs` is citation.inator's import bundle at **0.4.0-preview.2** (commit `7c54231`, branch
`codex/citation-import`), copied unchanged so draft.inator's importer can be built and tested before 0.4.0 is out. It
is not a release. Replace it with the same file from citation.inator's v0.4.0 release before this reaches a draft.inator
release.
